mapper.select: SELECT DATE(created_at) AS usageDate, COUNT(*) AS totalUsageCount, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN recommendation_type = 'LOAN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS loanUsageCount, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN recommendation_type = 'INSURANCE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS insuranceUsageCount, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN recommendation_type = 'ACCOUNT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS accountUsageCount FROM recommendation_usage_logs WHERE created_at >= #{startedAt} GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY usageDate ASC
